title: Innovating to zero! | Bill Gates
summary: Bill Gates' TED2010 talk on the energy future, arguing for zero global carbon emissions by 2050 and the need for energy miracles. He explains why he is backing a different type of nuclear reactor.
why: HN mostly cites it in nuclear power debates as Gates making the case that nuclear is needed for clean energy, with a few critical references to his views on population.

quote.text: Here's Bill Gates explaining why nuclear is not optional
